About Us

Pioneering Wellness Since 1983

Our Story

Jaguar Fitness began with a singular vision: to create equipment that doesn't just train the body, but inspires the human spirit.

For over four decades, we have been at the forefront of the fitness revolution, combining biomechanical precision with Italian design elegance. What started as a small workshop has grown into a global leader in wellness solutions, powering Olympic villages, luxury hotels, and private homes around the world.

Our Mission

To help people live better everywhere. We believe that movement is the key to a healthy life. Our mission is to promote the Wellness lifestyle—a balanced approach to life that includes regular physical activity, a healthy diet, and a positive mental attitude.

Sustainability

We define business success not just by financial results, but by our environmental and social impact. Jaguar Fitness is committed to sustainable manufacturing, reducing our carbon footprint, and creating products that last a lifetime.
